div.div:
Muxes: inputs labeled with the select value. Select names in blue match the RTL.
Net labels (e.g. ex_fwd_a at SIMD/MULDIV/CSRS) mark connections drawn by name to keep wires readable.
Line jumps mark unavoidable crossings; a dot marks a junction.
Single clock domain: clk and rst reach every register (not drawn).
